_comment: The TUI's pickers read the kconfig-only Registry, so a Roadrunner, CMake or PlatformIO type the CLI tracks did not exist in the menu. The type list is what every picker reads; menuconfig still offers kconfig types only; add-serial reaches the CLI handler for a non-kconfig type.

mutations.name: the type picker reads every declared type, not the kconfig registry's
mutations.replace: return [e for e in typelist.load(cli.ctx().paths) if e.builder == "kconfig_make"]

mutations.name: menuconfig offers kconfig types only
mutations.find:
mcu_type = pick_mcu_type(allow_new=True, accepts=kconfig_type)
    if mcu_type is None:
        return
    fw = pick_fw_target()
mutations.replace:
mcu_type = pick_mcu_type(allow_new=True)
    if mcu_type is None:
        return
    fw = pick_fw_target()

mutations.name: add-serial reaches the CLI handler for a non-kconfig type
